intro: Trying to find Florida undergraduate scholarships that take financial need into account usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and sponsor preferences. This filtered slice narrows that search to a focused set of USA listings tied to Florida and undergraduate study, so you can compare options with less noise. The programs below span categories such as education, community, STEM, medicine, arts, and miscellaneous topics, with some listings connected to fields like engineering, business, health professions, and visual or performing arts. Award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and eligibility details can include residency or citizenship language. Many rows appear to have lighter application signals and often no essay, but you should still verify every requirement on the official page before you apply.
